articleTitle: A Study on Support Vector Machine based Linear and Non-Linear Pattern Classification
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: The best way to acquire knowledge about an algorithm is feeding it data and checking the result. In a layman's language machine learning can be called as an ideological child or evolution of the idea of understanding algorithm through data. Machine learning can be subdivided into two paradigms, supervised learning and unsupervised learning. Supervised learning is implemented to classify data using algorithms like support vector machines (SVM), linear regression, logistic regression, neural networks, nearest neighbor etc. Supervised learning algorithm uses the concepts of classification and regression. Linear classification was earlier used to form the decision plane but was bidimensional. But a particular dataset might have required a non linear decision plane. This gave the idea of the support vector machine algorithm which can be used to generate a non linear decision boundary using the kernel function. SVM is a vast concept and can be implemented on various real world problems like face detection, handwriting detection and many more. This paper surveys the various concepts of support vector machines, some of its real life applications and future aspects of SVM.

articleTitle: A Study of LBPH, Eigenface, Fisherface and Haar-like features for Face recognition using OpenCV
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Facial recognition is a major challenge in the field of computer vision. Here we have implemented various facial recognition algorithms like LBPH, Eigenface and Fisherface. Haar cascade has been used for facial identification. We trained the algorithms using the same data set and have got some insights, from which we have tried to identify which algorithm gives us the best results. Different algorithms are compared and their workings are discussed. At the end, tabular comparisons are provided. So that it would be easier to understand the difference between algorithms.

articleTitle: Simulation and Performance Analysis of Feature Extraction and Matching Algorithms for Image Processing Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Feature extraction and matching has the limelight in all almost all the fields ranging from biomedical to exploratory research. It has ubiquitous applications in present world that is moving at a breathtaking pace towards automation. The algorithms used for feature extraction are application specific, i.e. the one that yields better performance for face recognition does not guarantee the same performance for lane detection. A lot of time is invested in identifying algorithms that are best suited for an application. In the interest of time, an attempt has been made to develop few good algorithm combinations that assist in the selection of algorithms. The features of input image and the target image are extracted, described and matched using various algorithm combinations like SURF, FAST, MSER, and Harris Corner Detector. The combination of all these algorithms is simulated on MATLAB using computer vision and image processing toolboxes. A Graphical User Interface (GUI) is developed for better user experience. Face recognition is considered as an example to perform the simulation. The results reflect that the combination of SURF and MSER performs better compared to other algorithm combinations when an image is scaled and rotated, however there are no good matches when there is also a pose variation. Proper thresholding of ‘Match Threshold’, ‘Reject Ratio’, and ‘Inlier Threshold’ must be carried out through trial and error method to get better results.

articleTitle: Supply Chain Management using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: As an attempt to collaborate the digital world with the physical one, we maintain a track of the journey of the dairy products from producer to consumer. IoT sensors can be linked to any product entrusted to someone else for transport, with traceable ownership, possession, and measurement parameters such as location, temperature, humidity, motion; for instance, milk, curd, etc. The final consumer can access a complete record of details and trust that the information is accurate and precise. One of the upcoming technologies, blockchain, is a great way for handling the quality of supply-chain management, since it uses the distributed public general ledger. Blockchain technology proves to be helpful in the supply-chain sector in the following manner: reduce errors, avoid product delays, eliminate fraudulent activities, improve management, increase consumer/supplier trust, and so on. In case of lack of transparency, blockchain provides recorded information about a variety of transactions in goods and/or services, which are recorded and tracked in real time.

articleTitle: Effective Design and Implementation of AMBA AHB Bus Protocol using Verilog
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: The computer's performance is intensely reliant on bus interconnect design. An ineffectively designed system bus can interfere with the transmission of guidelines and the information between the memory and processor or between the peripheral gadgets and memory. The Advanced Microcontroller Bus Architecture (AMBA) specification defines high-performance microcontroller on-chip communication standards. AHB is part of the AMBA convention family. The AMBA AHB is designed for high-performance, high-clock system modules. The AHB acts as the system's high-performance backbone bus. AHB supports the efficient connection of low-power macro cell peripheral functions to processors, on-chip memories and external off-chip memory interfaces. All signal transitions relate only to the rising clock edge, so that AHB peripherals can easily be integrated into any design flow. This paper describes AMBA AHB design and implementation using Verilog. The read/write operation was implemented using Xilinx simulator®.

articleTitle: Stock Price Prediction Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: In today's economy, there is a profound impact of the stock market or equity market. Prediction of stock prices is extremely complex, chaotic, and the presence of a dynamic environment makes it a great challenge. Behavioural finance suggests that decision-making process of investors is to a very great extent influenced by the emotions and sentiments in response to a particular news. Thus, to support the decisions of the investors, we have presented an approach combining two distinct fields for analysis of stock exchange. The system combines price prediction based on historical and real-time data along with news analysis. LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory) is used for predicting. It takes the latest trading information and analysis indicators as its input. For news analysis, only the relevant and live news is collected from a large set of business new. The filtered news is analyzed to predict sentiment around companies. The results of both analyses are integrated together to get a response which gives a recommendation for future increases.

articleTitle: Power Reduction of Half Adder and Half Subtractor Using Different Partial Adiabatic Logic Styles
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: With the increasing growth of VLSI technologies the number of gates per chip is constantly increasing, as a result power dissipation increases and heat removal becomes complex and expensive. Therefore, power dissipation is one of the critical issue in low power circuits in VLSI design. Adiabatic logic is a promising technique used in low power VLSI circuits to achieve high level of performance with limiting power consumption. In Adiabatic logic, power consumption /dissipation occurring at the time of switching event is avoidable as the power supply retrieve the charge from node capacitance without heat generation which is contradict to conventional CMOS logic style and also power saving more than 50% is achievable in case of partial adiabatic circuits when compared to conventional CMOS circuits but with increase in circuit complexity. The simulation is carried out for half adder and half subtractor using 180nm CMOS technology in Cadence Virtuoso environment. From the obtained results, it is found that average power saving is more for half adder and half subtractor implemented using PFAL technique when compared to other techniques of partial adiabatic logic including conventional CMOS logic.

articleTitle: An efficient task scheduling in a cloud computing environment using hybrid Genetic Algorithm - Particle Swarm Optimization (GA-PSO) algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Cloud computing provides the computational machines as a support of the clients utilizing cloud organize. In cloud computing, the user inputs are executed with required machines to convey the administrations. Numerous task scheduling methods are utilized to plan the client tasks to the machines. In this paper, another successful hybrid task scheduling is proposed to minimize the total execution time using Genetic Algorithm (GA) and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithms. In hybrid Genetic Algorithm - Particle Swarm Optimization (GA-PSO) algorithm, PSO helped GA to obtain better results compare to a standard genetic algorithm, Min-Min, and Max-Min algorithms results.

articleTitle: Contemplate on Internet of Things Transforming as Medical Devices - The Internet of Medical Things (IOMT)
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: IoT devices provide efficient usage of technology and better innovation to ecosystem in healthcare. The Largest industries of all being HealthCare, IoT is changing and stepping a head to connect than ever in all terms. By the coming decade the Health Care will take a leading step literally. IoT in HealthCare named as IoMT of devices in Medical are equipped with WiFi. These are allowed to be communicated through machine-to-machine that links to services of Amazon Web via cloud platforms. The Platforms captures stored data and analyse it. The Industries has to maintain standards as there are huge number of product landscape and improving stage of technology forces companies of medical devices to be carefully in terms of IoT strategies. Having some setbacks in healthcare industry which demands attention. Many of the Healthcare Organizations are still not using the amount of data which is available with them and there are many unnoticed problems which require a solution that means there is a need of usage of IoT. HealthCare Organizations need to be provided a solution that results in better maintenance of the sectors which are in healthcare that are integrated.

articleTitle: Efficient Portable Camera Based Text to Speech Converter for Blind Person
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Text Reader for Blind Person using camera module ensuring portability is the prototype made using the Raspberry Pi 3b and Python to read the text from the handheld objects of the blind person. This paper proposes a better approach for text localization and extraction for detection of text areas in the images. The text size is an important factor whose dimension should be properly elected to make the method more general and insensitive to various font shapes and sizes. The proposed method involves four steps detection of an object, localization of the text, extraction of the text and text to speech conversion. The Region of Interest is extracted from the cluttered background and then the text localization algorithm is applied to locate and extract the text. After extracting the text from the ROI, it is converted it into speech. It works more efficiently with Optical Character Recognition. Convolutional recurrent neural network is proposed for training the words separately. The experiment and training are performed on Synth 90k word dataset. Finally using OCR and CRNN a proposed model has been developed.

articleTitle: A Survey and Challenges in IoT Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: The Internet has become an important part of today's human lifestyle. Due to massive demand and need, researchers went further than just using computers to access the internet. These researchers led to the birth of the Internet of Things. It also has some issues such as energy-efficient communication, installation cost, inconvenience to users, management of large sensed data and the interoperability among domains. This paper presents a survey on issues such as energy efficient communication among nodes, interoperability between different heterogeneous data and domains, and data management of huge sensed data.

articleTitle: Implementation of IOT based Attendance Management System on Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: The biometric-based attendance monitoring system replaces the manual method of taking attendance and reduces the time to take attendance and avoids proxy. There are many biometric methods developed based on the fingerprint recognition, DNA matching, face recognition, Iris recognition and voice recognition. Out of all, the methods based on face recognition are proved to be the best methods. In this paper we are presenting the implementation of attendance monitoring system based on the facial recognition. In this method the image database of the classroom is created first and the database is used to train the system. Then in recognition phase the camera is fixed at the focal point in the classroom and it will capture the images, then from the captured images student's faces are recognized & compared with the database and lastly the attendance is marked based on the faces identified. The marked attendance is directly reported to the students/parents and to the faculty handling the respective course. In this method, Haar cascade classifier is used to detect the faces and captured images are compared with the database by using local binary pattern histogram algorithm. The face recognition system is implemented on the Raspberry Pi 3B hardware.

articleTitle: External Archive Based Adaptive Differential Evaluation for Solution of Economic Load Dispatch
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: The objective of this paper is to propose solution of Economic load dispatch using ADEEA algorithm. Economic load dispatch is non linear problem, all the parameters like real & reactive power, voltage magnitudes, transformer tapings, phase angles, reactive power injections has minimum and maximum limits. Differential evaluation is an effective method to solve the non linear problems. In the optimization process control parameters are needed to change, it is called as “Self Adaptive Differential Evaluation”. The proposed algorithm is derived from SADE. In some special problems the historical data is very useful so by adding the historical data externally to the differential evaluation system it reduces the cost of generation. The proposed algorithm is tested on bench mark IEEE 30 bus structure and it gives the best solution with good convergence ratio.

articleTitle: A Review on Automatic Number Plate Recognition Technology and Methods
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Automatic Number Plate Recognition system i.e. ANPR system identifies vehicle number plate. This system is used in various application like Traffic management, Parking management, Parking fee collection, Border crossings, finding position of steal cars etc. due to some factor like weather condition, light issue, inappropriate size of plate. It is difficult to identify the number plate. This paper presents existing techniques and methods of ANPR system. It show the steps of number plate detection and existing methods.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of 8-bit LFSR, Bit-Swapping LFSR and Weighted Random Test Pattern Generator: A Performance Improvement
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: The power dissipation during the testing cycle is more than that of the normal working of the chip. One reason is that as the chip size is being diminished the power dissemination of the circuit is likewise lessened. Adding a little overhead to the circuit for the purpose of testing which can remove the use of complex external testing component is the method called as Built In Self Test (BIST). In BIST the LFSR is utilized to produce the irregular patterns for testing of a VLSI circuit. This paper describes of a conventional linear feedback shift register, BS-LFSR and multiple WRTPG.

Author Keywords: AWRTPG-Arithmetic Weighted Random Test Pattern Generator

articleTitle: A Survey on Placement of Sensor Nodes in Deployment of Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN) denotes a set of geometrically dispersed and identified sensor nodes for recording and maintaining the environment and physical states and manages the obtained information at the center. The number of nodes and their locations is directly proportional to the coverage area of the sensor nodes and are referred as coverage pints. The placement of sensor nodes has become an important challenge in covering a small parametric and physical change that occurs in particular location. In wireless networks such issues were based on placement of sensor nodes. This influences the performance of wireless sensor network storage connectivity and resilience. For wireless Sensors many deployment schemes has been proposed. This paper describes about the comparative analysis of the various deployment strategies of sensor nodes with the random placement in these networks using voronoi diagram. The random deployment of sensor nodes in WSN will be helpful for avoiding some of the problems in applications like crowd management, occurrence of accidents etc. By maintaining the network connectivity the proposed algorithm decreases the redundancy and removes the isolated nodes. Lastly, the to heal coverage holes the algorithm tries to divide the field into different voronoi cells and tries to deploy nodes were ever required and thus nodes are moved into their local best positions according to Voronoi partition.

articleTitle: Students Performance Prediction Using Data Mining Techniques
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Data Mining is a rising field utilized in educational purposes to enhance the insightful and learning strategy for students. It centers around perceiving, extricating and calculating information related to the educational procedure and rising student performance. Mining in a learning field is known as educational data mining with investigating most recent strategies to search out data from instructional fields. The aim behind our study is to judge the students performance by taking different parameters like scholastic accomplishments (CGPA), sex, class test grade, condition of class, Fund/Scholarships/Private and so on. In our exploration we will utilize classification and clustering Bayesian classification-mean algorithms, neural networks, Naive bayes, Web based system and nearest neighbor methods strategies to investigate understudy execution. The issue is to distinguish the student whose execution is poor in their courses. So as indicated by their execution and capacity, there will be an opportunity to take some remedial activities. In this paper, we anticipate the last grades utilizing diverse information mining calculations to foresee the last execution of students with the goal that we can get increasingly precise qualities. It issues a prediction for each student solely when the normal precision of the forecast is satisfactory.

articleTitle: Survey on Internet of Things based Smart Home
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) enables tiny sensors and actuators to be more accessible and responsive. Researchers have applied IoT techniques in different domains such as health monitoring, agriculture, food supply, smart city and so on. In these applications, IoT technologies enabled the end user to monitor and control different devices from remote places. To increase security and provide variant facilities in a home environment, researchers applied IoT to create a smart home. This paper contains a study of different IoT based smart home techniques, we have classified IoT based smart home techniques into two categories namely, IoT based Smart Home Automation and IoT based Smart Home Security Systems. In this study, we have discussed various sensors, doorways, and communication protocols used in IoT based smart home.

articleTitle: Micro - Strip Patch Antenna Using Various Types of Feeding Techniques: An Implementation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: This paper tries to implement Micro-Strip rectangular patch antenna and tries to analyze its performance for various types of feeding techniques. FR4 epoxy is utilized as a substrate. The 2D and 3D radiation pattern are also discussed. The parameter scattering matrix is analyzed. This design is intended for its operation on the L-band. The L-band has a bandwidth of 17% over the band range of 1.6GHz – 1.8GHz. This system generates the model of the Micro - Strip Antenna for various feeding techniques using HFSS Ansoft 13.0 tool.

articleTitle: A Review on Detection Approaches for Distributed Denial of Service Attacks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: In recent time among multiple attacks occurs in a network system, DDoS attack is the most common attack with main disturbing effect. DDoS is the serious security threat, it challenge the accessibility of resources to legitimate clients. This attack causes the denial of service to genuine user due to flooding of traffic from unauthorized user. Various kind of DDoS attack are identified which include tcp, syn flood, ping flood attack, udp flood, smurf attack. Researchers have used various defense mechanisms for detection of DDoS attack, various data mining algorithm is also used for detection approach Clustering, classification, regression, neural network, Bayesian are few of the algorithm which previously used for attack detection. From research analysis, clustering and classification algorithm of data mining gives best result in terms of accuracy, time, true positive, true negative, false positive and false negative rate and detection rate. When clustering algorithm combines with classification algorithm give high accuracy. In this paper we are going to discuss varied study conducted by different researchers.

articleTitle: Blockchain implimentation on E-voting System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Day to day revolutionizing technology is coming up with their positive impacts on our social life. And this all-time globally connected network enables us to access variety of resources easily. One such revolution is Blockchain. With its special characteristics of immutability and decentralized architecture, many services are shifting towards it. One potential application of blockchain can be found in e-voting schemes. It has been a challenge since a long time for building an e-voting system which satisfies all legal requirements of legislators. Distributed ledger technologies can offer infinite range of applications. This paper discusses various e-voting system frameworks conceptualized by different teams. Blockchain will bring its benefits on e-voting systems including immutability of votes, security of system, real-time validation and updation of count of votes in global ledger with not depending upon number of nodes in the network.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of Multi-junction TANDEM Solar Cell
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: This paper manages with the modelling of quadruple junction solar cell (qjsc) constructed by using the semiconductor material of AlGaInP-GaAs-GaInAs-Ge at a particular value solar irradiance, temperature. Comparison of output I-V and P-V curve of quadruple junction solar cell is done with triple junction solar cell made up of InGaP-InGaAs-Ge semiconductor material and also single junction solar cell (sjsc) made of a Ge semiconductor by using MATLAB/SIMULINK. It has been found higher value of output voltage and power in quadruple junction solar cell as compared to single, dual or triple junction solar cell. The above described quadruple junction solar cell is made by using the material having a same lattice structure which helps to ease the flow of current in all the four junctions and analysis is done at solar irradiance (1000-800-500) W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The whole analysis is done through pessimistic approach on the basis of the single exponential model.

articleTitle: Smart Portable Assisted Device for Visually Impaired People
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: This paper aims to present a designed and developed version of a portable, low powered instrument to make lives of visually impaired people of the world, while they walk on road easier. About 47.7 million people in India suffer from moderate to severe vision problems, whereas 253 million visually impaired people are estimated in worldwide population. The issue is that there is no such production worthy prototype available to ease the travelling experience for these people. The intended device is built on low power embedded hardware and software technologies, sensors and sensing technologies, to harness for a social cause, serves to the need of the visually impaired people. The device is a miniaturized, non-invasive, portable, low power and convenient device for the blind people. It is able to detect the obstruction in front of a road upto a certain distance in all the three dimensions in space and also to detect the potholes or speed brakers on the road by a combination of pressure sensors and distance sensor embedding into the device. With varying distance of obstacle from the box attached to the walking stick, the speaker would respond with voice messages denoting the distance of obstruction in metres (m) so that he can be alerted. We designed an App that can be opened using the volume turn up button on an android phone, keeping in mind about our user's disabilities (as he is visually impaired). The entire data, i.e., his current location and intended destination, would be sent to anothr app in another android device that would be with his most confidential person/caregivers, wherein his current location would be monitored.

articleTitle: High Performance Induction Machine Drive Using Rotor Field Oriented Control
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: This paper shows strategies of adjustable speed induction machine drives. In this scenario, either by controlling stator voltage/frequency, the desired speed control can be obtained or by controlling voltage and frequency with the ratio v/f constant. These are scalar methods. Good speed control is achieved at the cost of starting and maximum torque by using the scalar methods. Field orientation method develops high performance induction machine drive. Magnitude and phase angle are controlled to achieve the controlled speed. Field oriented control means the orientation of d-q coordinate reference frame on the rotor and stator flux vector. This orientation is used to achieve the decoupling between motor flux and torque. They can be controlled separately such as dc motor by controlling stator direct axis and quadrature axis current. This orientation needs three phase current which are achieved using only one sensor. The results are obtained using MATLAB Simulink

Author Keywords: field oriented control high performance drive

articleTitle: A Novel Designing and Testing of Two - Way Wilkinson Power Divider
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Wilkinson Power Divider is a passive component used in wireless communication as a key device, for dividing RF microwave power. A 2-way Wilkinson power divider at intermediate frequency 456MHz was designed and implemented using FR4 substrate is proposed in this paper. This method consists of one resistor connected between 2 output ports. ADS 2011.10 used to simulate the design and have been implemented using FR4 Substrate. An insertion loss, return loss (or VSWR) and isolation with the good result was measured using S-parameter.

articleTitle: A Review on DNA based Cryptography for Data hiding
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: In today's world, securing data is becoming one of the main issues, the elaboration of the fusion of cryptography and steganography are contemplating as the sphere of on-going research. This can be gain by cryptography, steganography, and fusion of these two, where message firstly encoding using any cryptography techniques and then conceal into any cover medium using steganography techniques. Biological structure of DNA is used as the cover medium due to high storage capacity, simple encoding method, massive parallelism and randomness DNA cryptography can be used in identification card and tickets. Currently work in this field is still in the developmental stage and a lot of investigation is required to reach a fully-fledged stage. This paper provides a review of the existing method of DNA based cryptography

articleTitle: Design of Double-tail Dynamic Latch Comparator for Low Power Application
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: The Analog to Digital Converter (ADC) is an important part of any signal processing system. It is used to convert the analog signal to digital signal. Power consumption and compactness are the main issues in an ADC. Among the different components of ADC comparator is the one which consumes more power. Dynamic latch comparators are the most suitable comparators for low power applications. A modified Double-tail latch comparator with reduced glitches for low frequency applications is presented in this paper. The total power consumed by the circuit is 296.171 pW at 1.8 V power supply. The simulation is carried out in Cadence Virtuoso environment using 180 nm CMOS technology.

articleTitle: Programmed Water Management System for Irrigation Using Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: The revolution of the Internet was the catalyst that changed the future of communication forever. Internet of things (IOT) is quickly expanding technology. IOT is the system of physical items or entities embedded with electronic software programming., sensors., and system connectivity, which empowers these entities to gather and trade information. In this paper introduces a model, which will consequently irrigate the plant and create Alerts/Alarms or take decisions utilizing idea of IOT when the water level is below threshold. The system consists of Arduino board, DC water motor, sensors, and Wi-Fi module for connection with cloud through internet. Sensors connected to Arduino board measure sensor readings, and then the readings are transmitted to the cloud through Wi-Fi module. A decision is taken locally based on the received data and this decision is applied to turn on the water motor, also the whole system can be controlled automatically via internet. We will propose this article as model for smart water management system for irrigation of south India areas dependent on the utilization of the Internet of Things and new communication technologies. The validation of our proposed system is proved by simulation results using Thinkspeak and SMS notification to the registered user is used by PushBullet.

articleTitle: Use of Vedic Mathematics to Speed-up Basic Mathematical Operations in Android Based Calculator
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Many times we use Vedic Sutras knowingly or unknowingly. For example, when we use i<-i-1 or i<-i+1 in our programming we use ‘EkanyunenaPurvena’ and ‘EkadhikinaPurvena’ Sutras respectively. Similarly, in computer's multiplier unit, many Vedic Sutras are being used. In our proposed application we have developed user interface for Vedic Multiplication and Vedic Addition in a calculator which is designed for Android based devices. This application reduces the complexity of mathematical calculations with the help of Vedic Mathematics. Vedic Multiplication and Vedic Addition, in our proposed calculator, can provide faster result than traditional methods. On the other hand, Vedic Multiplication and Vedic Addition consumes less power. Therefore, our proposed application not only saving power consumption but also speeds-up basic mathematical operations and reduces the computational overhead.

articleTitle: Design of a corner truncated patch antenna array with four elements for wireless applications
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: A compact dual band 2×2 array antenna for wireless applications in X and Ku band frequencies is presented in this paper. The array antenna in this work adopted a 2×2 array configuration with corporate feeding network to have equal phase and current magnitudes. A corner truncated microstrip patch array is designed to have circular polarization. The proposed antenna is resonating at 10.48 GHz and 12.55 GHz with maximum radiating gain of about 11dBi. The corner truncated patch array is having an axial ratio of 0.17 dB with a bandwidth of 270 MHz at center frequency of 12.64 GHz. This antenna array can be used in different wireless communication applications in X and Ku band frequencies.

articleTitle: Investigation for Optimal Structure of CdS/SnS Solar Cell from Numerical Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: In this paper the absorber layer of Tin mono-sulfide(SnS) thin film had been explored as an absorber layer of solar cell using the one dimensional simulator AMPS-1D.(Analysis of Microelectronic and Photonic Structures). The studies conducted by emphasize given to the SnS absorber layer thickness effect of the operating temperature and sun intensity with cell structure “ITO/ZnO/CdS/SnS/Ag”. The thickness of SnS thin film has been changed from 1000nm to 2000nm. The best efficiency of 13.2% is obtained at the highest thickness 2000nm at operating temperature is 3500C under 1sun. The study highlights the effect of thickness on the SnS absorber layer thin film solar cell.

articleTitle: Hardware in Loop Simulation of a Way Point Navigation Using Matlab/Simulink and X-Plane Simulator
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: This paper presents the hardware in loop simulation of a waypoint navigation using Mat lab/Simulink and X-plane simulator. The simulation has been carried out in Matlab/Simulink software and interfacing with X-plane simulator. HILS is used for the testing of the hardware that is implemented on an onboard UAV/Aircraft. User Datagram Protocol (UDP) does data transmission between X-plane and Matlab/Simulink. Waypoints are taken as input, which denote the latitude and longitude. The distance between the two waypoints are calculated using Haversine formula. The work demonstrated in this paper is to run the simulation using software (i.e.,) control command is given in Matlab/Simulink blocks and simulation is run in X-plane simulator. After a detailed study, the control algorithm has been implemented in hardware and the simulation process will be executed.

articleTitle: The application of quadrilateral finite element mesh generation technique for the analysis of cutoff wave number in rectangular with curved wave guide
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: This paper presents, the numerical solution of cutoff wave numbers in rectangular with curved boundaries of the wave guide have been investigated by Galerkin finite element method, the finite element approach with quadrilateral mesh or grid over the region is employed, the effectiveness of the method is illustrated with numerical examples and also compare the results with previous work done.

articleTitle: Design Techniques for Low Power High Gain OTA Using Miller Circuit
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: The power consumption has become a critical issue, and hence a great attention and high importance is given to design of low voltage(LV) low power (LP) and high gain integrated circuits in last few decades. In order to achieve high performance analog circuits are usually combined with digital circuits in mixed signal systems. Opamp's are highly power hungry analog block used in large number of applications. Hence OTAs are preferred over Opamp. As technology scales down OTA design becomes more challenging since supply voltage scales down but keeping threshold voltage relatively constant. This paper deals with design of gate driven and bulk driven OTA using cadence virtuoso in 180nm technology with the supply voltage 1.6 V and 0.4 V respectively. Different performance parameter like DC gain, power consumption, transconductance, gain margin and phase margin, CMRR and unity gain bandwidth are analyzed.

articleTitle: Bandwidth Augmentation of Microstrip Patch Antenna in Wireless Sensor Framework
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: This work presents a 2.4GHz (ISM band) patch antenna which is simulated for wireless sensors network. The proposed work shows improvement in the bandwidth of micro strip antenna is possible by inserting slot/s in the patch. This work proposed a patch antenna is designed for 2.4GHz with FR4 substrate having dielectric constant (εr) of 4.4 & thickness of 1.6mm. From the results it can be conclude that the improvement in bandwidth and return loss is possible by inserting a slot in the patch. The results shows that, the proposed antenna has −10dB bandwidth of 119MHz and Return loss of −20dB which is further improved to 154 MHz & return loss of −27 dB by using a slot. Proposed antenna exibits good performance of in terms of bandwidth and return loss making it suitable for wireless sensor network.

articleTitle: Privacy Preserving Using Pup-Rup Model
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Cloud services are exponentially growing day by day, roughly around 2.5 quintillion bytes of data created each day [1]. Many companies provide cloud services like cloud storage for your data, since it is in the hands of the third-party service provider, you will be left with privacy concern. While one can opt for a personal cloud device and store the data as the only drive with data, theft may render user without any chance of recoverability of the data. Our paper proposes a PUP-RUP (Privacy Under Personal cloud - Recoverability Under Public cloud) model, which addresses the privacy concerns in public cloud and recoverability issue in personal cloud by using both public and personal cloud where personal cloud device holds the sensitive data which can be shared with a shared link to the group of users and encrypting the same data it is stored in the public cloud which makes data unusable to the third-party service providers without key, maintained by user. We will see how PUP-RUP model perform against existing models.

articleTitle: A Review on Blockchain Urgency in the Internet of Things in Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: With the growing use of the internet, new technology came into the existence and it is on the same edge now, where decades ago the internet was. Internet of things (IoT) is facing many security issues. Due to the lack of the security standards, industries are afraid to take a risk with IoT. In the Healthcare industry where data is vast and valuable, it is risky to use IoT with it. It can compromise the patient's security. In this paper, various methods are discussed for Healthcare issues in IoT, by several researchers. Mainly the research work is focused on the different solutions proposed in the healthcare for IoT. At the end, a theoretical analysis of proposed solution is done.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Approach for Enhancing Security in Internet of Things (IoT)
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: The term Internet of things (IoT) is referred as the network of devices like home appliances, physical devices, automobiles that are fixed with software, sensors, electronics and network connectivity which allows the devices to connect and perform data exchange. The communication that occurs between the devices over internet is through IP address. Internet of Things is currently in its initial stage. In the impending years it is going to influence our day to day life. The more it will be included in our lifestyle, more will be the threat of it being misused. There is an immediate need to strongly protect data during data transfers. This paper proposes a hybrid encryption algorithm HAR(Hybrid AES Rail Fence) for secure data communication among IoT devices. The proposed Encryption algorithm ensures confidentiality, so the attackers cannot interpret the cipher text and shows better results in comparison with conventional encryption algorithms.

articleTitle: A Review on Game based Steganography
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Steganography is defined in terms of hidden or secret communication. It is hiding the presence of information or data from the unauthorized users. Therefore, we need a medium that hides the message or work as cover media for steganography. Many multimedia files such as Image, audio, video etc. are very frequently used for a cover medium in steganography. Other than these It Is also possible to use video games as the cover medium that makes a message more undetectable. In this paper reviews the game based steganography methods. The minesweeper video game is used as the cover medium. It is freely available online. We use Minesweeper game because of its availability and the hiding capacity.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Battery/Ultracapacitor Hybrid Energy Storage System for Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Preservation of environment and energy conservation has caused the advancement of Electric Vehicles (EVs), Energy Storage System (ESS) plays an essential role in superior and durable performance of EV. In peak power demand condition battery will have to provide more power in a short duration. For which battery is not entirely capable of. To meet the peak power demand of the vehicle battery is combined with Ultracapacitor (UC). UC has a high power density than the battery. In this paper, battery/UC HESS is discussed. Ultracapacitor voltage is kept higher than the battery voltage in this Hybrid Energy Storage System (HESS). Battery will only provide power when ultracapacitor voltage goes below battery voltage. By using adequate power management, maximum system performance along with less power consumption can lead to extended battery life.

articleTitle: Android Home Automation using PIC Micro Controller and Bluetooth
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: The strategy of the project is to control the use of electrical loads which is used with the aid of Android application. The electrical loads are supervised by Bluetooth incoming data from the used Android device. Always to ON and OFF these switches it became distressed and even it had became an issue for physically disabled persons. The device aids Android devices which are responsible for transmitting incoming data, here the android device means the device having the android OS irrespective of the device like phone or tablet. In order to have this favor, the app gives an powerful Graphical User Interface (GUI). The system used here is the PIC microcontroller which is linked with the Bluetooth receiver to receive commands and then to react as per the requested commands. The loads are worked by using relay driver IC's. In between the load and the control unit relays are used. The proposed system is very helpful for household applications and mechanical setups.

articleTitle: Serial Concatenated Convolution Codes for Coded OFDM in Digital Audio Broadcasting Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: In this paper, we are simulating the Bit Error Rate (BER) for computerized Digital Audio Broadcasting (DAB) framework that utilizes Co-OFDM system by parallel and serial coding schemes. Serial convolution coded data appears to be an Additive White Gaussian Noise (AWGN) Channel that is dependent on various imperative constant dimensions and code originator polynomial values obtained by convolution coding. Bit error rate simulations are done by applying sound signal and then estimating their performance with BER execution for the convolution coded. Serial convolution with various processor speeds 1/2 and 1/3 in AWGN is increasingly dependent on the perceptual coding. It is estimated, measured and plotted for developing a convolution coded DAB system environment.

articleTitle: A Review on Traffic Engineering Techniques in Software Defined Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Software DefinedNetworking (SDN) is considered as a promising approach in networking paradigm. It distinguishes the control plane of the network from the plane which is used for data forwarding. This technique not only helps in optimal resource utilization in the network, but it also simplifies the complexity in management of the network, reduces the operating cost of the network and also encourages the innovative and evolutionary ideas. An emerging way to achieve this requirement that optimizes a network and helps in the improvisation of the network robustness is traffic engineering. Traffic Engineering can reduce link failure and service degradation in the network. Research communities have worked a lot on methods for traditional networking structures, which allows the network to adapt to the changes in traffic patterns. This paper mainly focuses on the review of the various state of the art methods for traffic engineering for Software Defined Network. It mainly concentrates on the techniques for traditional network architecture and to study the challenges in the implementation and future scope of such methods.

articleTitle: A review on Hyperspectral Image Classification using SVM combined with Guided Filter
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: The classification of hyperspectral remote detecting picture is testing assignment in present time. In this survey hyperspectral picture characterization utilizing SVM joined with the guided filter to get the spatial data viably and de-commotion the grouping result by edge-preserving smoothing property. In the paper [1], spatial data for hyperspectral picture classification gathered using morphological profile and local binary pattern. To, begin with, image classifier is utilized to group every pixel and after that apply the guided filter for edge-smoothing property otherwise called edge-preserving filtering(EPF) to the outcome which is utilized to enhance classification exactness. When it is contrasted with existing customary classification techniques, it may provide better classification exactness. It will be beneficial for future remote-detecting image classification.

articleTitle: Assessment of Extended MNIST (EMNIST) dataset using Capsule Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Image recognition is always been a most seek able research topic for many years. There is a development to compare various models with more datasets because of the novelty that is exhibited in each architecture. In this paper, we compare three models AlexNet, VGGNet and GoogleNet with Capsule Networks for the Extended MNIST dataset. We also illustrate the goodness of previous model inspite of the lack in accuracy. We have showed the highest accuracy produced by the capsule network in object detection.

articleTitle: Smart Parking System Using Genetic Optimization: A Review
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: As the population increases, the number of vehicle on the road also increases exponentially. This results in vehicular traffic with a delay in finding parking space, which then results in traffic congestion and environmental pollution. This paper provides the use of various sensors in smart parking system and the optimization done by using genetic algorithms. The magnetic sensors, ultrasonic sensors, radar sensors, infrared sensors are used to sense the status of the parking slot. The genetic algorithm and ant colony optimization techniques are used to find the nearest appropriate and unoccupied parking slot. Further in this paper we have proposed a smart parking system solution with a speedy genetic algorithm for an effective path optimization

articleTitle: Optimizing System Efficiency and Performance using Tree Based Indexing Scheme
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: In today's world of digitalization, the scope of wireless data broadcast (bcast) still persists. Many day-to-day applications such as stock market, news, entertainment industry, sports industry etc. use data broadcasting. Being in use for more than a decade, there is still a possibility of improvement in the system efficiency and performance. Average Access Latency (AAL) and Average Tuning Time (ATT) are two major criterions to assess the performance of such system. There a number of indexing schemes available but the authors have redesigned, evaluated and compared certain most popular tree based indexing, i.e. Huffman and B<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> tree index. Our communication model combined the existing as well as a new theory of probability to evaluate the system performance. Numerical simulations have been carried out to compare both the tree indices in terms of AAL and ATT. After a detailed analysis, a more perceptive assessment has also been presented to make the outcome more evident. Present study shows that the Huffman indexing outperforms the B<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> tree index at various fronts.

articleTitle: A 7.69 GHz High Speed Dual Modulus Prescaler: Using True Single Phase Clock
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Due to intensive scaling in today's industries it has become very imperative to design circuits which can work at high frequencies. This paper is basically based on the design of a 2/3 prescaler. In this paper, we introduce 2/3 prescaler which can work up to 7.69 gigahertz. The measurement results show that this design in 180 nm on Cadence virtuoso works at 7.69 gigahertz for divide by 2 and divide by 3 respectively. Power supply used is 1.8 Voltage and input signal voltages 1.2. The total power consumed by the circuit is 3.63 mw and 3.75 mw who divide by 2 and divided by 3 respectively.

articleTitle: Routing Protocols Based on Cluster in Wireless Sensor Networks: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Wireless sensor network is a network of devices which are connected via sensor nodes that are mostly deployed in unaspirated location. Sensor nodes are self-deployable and organize themselves which sense the location and collects the information from the sensor node to base station. For such data gathering purpose several routing protocols are designed for easy way to communicate. The communication from source node to sink node is managed by number of routing protocols. The performance of sensor nodes merely depends on routing protocols. For such reason a survey based on routing protocols are carried out. There are number of routing protocols exists based on the network structure. Various cluster based routing protocols are examined and compared with different metrics for better performance. Furthermore, this paper deals with clustering methodology, rotation of cluster heads, optimization techniques and several clustering routing algorithms to prevent the loads that makes the sensor nodes overburden in the network. It is concluded that this paper will be with some way for future research field on clustering based routing protocols.

articleTitle: Genetic Algorithm Approach improved by 2D Lifting Scheme for Sensor Node Placement in Optimal Position
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: In this smart connected world, Sensors are scattered in the environment of interest in order to perform a surveillance monitoring activity for the target operational research. In order to cover the target, sensor node placement plays a crucial role to cover maximum target and minimum node connectivity with limited nodes. Sensor data gathering can be achieved by using important principle node connectivity. Signals in sensor network carry a large amount of data and retaining important information is often more difficult. To overcome this problem we propose a genetic algorithm based node placement the result is improved by wavelets to achieve a maximum coverage and connectivity. The experimental result is carried out to improve the quality of covered data with limited sensor in optimal positions.

articleTitle: Hyperbolic Distance-based NLOS Nodes Detection Mechanisms in VANETs: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Reliable data dissemination in the process of emergency message transfer is considered as the most important entity that needs to ensured in order to provide a timely response to any critical event on the vehicular network. Moreover, the response of the vehicle in the event of an emergency is yet another factor that needs to be facilitated for a smooth arrival of the ambulances and the rescue vehicles to the appropriate spot at a necessitated time. But, the Non Line of Sight Nodes (NLOS) in the vehicular network is responsible for reducing the response time of the vehicles at an emergency time, since the degree of cooperation between the vehicular nodes is disturbed by the presence of NLOS nodes in the network. In this paper, a review on the most notable research works contributed in the literature for focusing on the localization of NLOS nodes in the vehicular networks with the view to enhance the rate of response of the vehicles during an emergency is presented. This paper also presents the merits and limitations of each of the reviewed papers with its evaluation quantified in terms of emergency message transfer rate, channel utilization rate and NLOS localization rate.

articleTitle: FPGA based Implementation of Low power CORDIC architecture
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: The coordinate rotation digital computer (CORDIC) is a shift-add algorithm used for rotating vectors in a plane. Several techniques are proposed in the literature for calculation of trigonometric functions which requires large memory usage. Due to the flexibility, CORDIC algorithm is best alternative and allows high quantization accuracy by maximizing word length. The linear-rate convergence creates the major problem in CORDIC algorithm with the source of word-length and iteration speed. The power consumption is also a major issues which affects the performance due to array of shift-add operations. For further improvement, in this paper, we propose a low power and high speed CORDIC design with an improved power control and hardware reduction techniques. We employ the canonical signed-digit (CSD) technique and Hcub algorithm for reducing the number of shifters and adder/subtractor in the design. Then, we proposed an adder based on the advanced Boolean logic technique. These three techniques are used to redesign the entire CORDIC logic stages in [16] thereby contributing in power consumption reduction. The functionality of proposed CORDIC algorithm is assessed through FPGA implementations. The simulation result shows that the proposed method has higher frequency of 78.91 %, 83.42%, 79.89% and 77.01 % when compared with other architectures.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Approach to Detect Epileptic Seizure
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Epileptic seizure is a disorder of brain activity, usually characterized by the recurrent discharge from the cortex of cerebrum which leads from vigorous shaking of limbs to physical injury like arching of spinal cord, stroke etc. However instead of monitoring the patient for long duration, we need an intelligent technique for the accurate detection of seizure with less consumption of time. Hence this work focuses on a hybrid computational intelligence technique for the analysis of Electroencephalogram (EEG) signal to detect epileptic seizure by taking the EEG scalp data of ten patients from an open source (CHB-MIT) and converting these collected data into signal for the accurate seizure detection. Thereafter four spectral features i.e energy, entropy, mean and standard deviation have been extracted from the EEG signal by an efficient feature extraction method such as Discrete Wavelet transform (DWT) followed by Genetic Algorithm (GA) based feature selection technique to remove redundant features for more estimable accuracy. Later on, the selected features are grouped into training and test data sets. Finally, these selected sets are classified by a robust classifier namely, Support Vector Machine (SVM) for the accurate detection of epileptic seizure. In the end, the accuracy of classified features before feature selection is compared with classified features after feature selection. From the simulation results it has been found that DWT with GA based feature selection technique enhances the seizure detection accuracy as compared to DWT detection method.

articleTitle: Software in the Loop Simulation of Formation Flying of Multi Rotor UAV
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Formation flying control methods in multi-UAV systems have different strategies, each method have its own advantages and disadvantages, Minimize the weaknesses of each technique are quite interesting and difficult. The two important and commonly used methods are leader-follower approach and another based on way points received from a ground station. Formation flying using software in the loop simulation (SITL) provides a platform to test and evaluate control algorithm before implement into the real-time environment. This paper discusses implementation of both leader-follower method and waypoint navigation in software in the loop simulation. Finally the results of various formations are discussed.

articleTitle: Survey on Diseased Leaf Using Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Agriculture plays a vital role in all living things but it has many challenges to cultivate something like plants and vegetables from diseases. Disease affecting in the plant or leaf is quite a natural, if proper care is taken or not taken plant will surely affect by the disease because of nature, climate, soil condition and also by water. Here, we mainly focus on the detection of a diseased leaf. To solve those challenges many techniques are used like Color space transformation, Neural Network, Preprocessing, Classification, Segmentation, and Extraction techniques are used. Any techniques can be used to detect disease from the leaf, but finding which can give the better solution from those techniques is hard because some techniques can give better result some may give low accuracy. In this paper, we mainly focus on Color Space transformation, Neural Network, Segmentation has many algorithms like region growing method and Morphological operation.

Author Keywords: morphological operation and region growing method

articleTitle: Accurate Fault Detection of Distribution Network with Optimal Placement of Phasor Measurement Unit
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: With increasing power system complexities, fault becomes more common which makes the equipments and workers exposed to catastrophes. Previously supervisory control and data acquisition(SCADA) system were used to monitor and detect fault in power system, but it's lower sampling rate makes it inappropriate to use. This paper presents an improved approach for fault detection in distribution line. The proposed method uses Phasor Measurement Units (PMU)to detect fault quickly and operate the circuit breakers(CB) to ensure system stability and security. For this purpose 30 kW generating station feeding power to 10 km distribution line with a step up transformer (208/11 kV) and a 24 kW solar photovoltaic(PV)module is used here. PMU's are installed at synchronous generator, PV grid, and load buses respectively. The data from the PMU are aligned and planned to IEEE C37.118 format before transmitted to the Phasor data concentrator. Here, positive sequence phase locked loop (PLL) based PMU is used to measure the power system parameters like voltage, frequency, and phase respectively. The large deviation in any parameter can be used to trigger the CB. Quick and Accurate fault detection in the distribution network eliminates any big catastrophic effect and saves from monetary loss. The performance of the proposed model can be evaluated by calculating Total Vector Error of the PMU and then comparing it with IEEE C37.118 standards. Proposed scheme also provides optimal placement of PMU in the given system.

articleTitle: A novel method for culminating the consumption of fast food using PCA Reduction and K-means Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Nowadays peoples are going fast. Everyone used to do all things fast. They spend most of the time to sleep in the morning from the last half an hour they get ready to go for their jobs. In this hurry burry situation they have no time to cook and eat. So they are eating outside food which is unhealthy fast food. Fast food is good in taste but not good in ingredients. Fast food has many types and continuous consumption of fast food may lead to various serious health issues. In this paper, presented preprocessing and clustering technique to find the impacts of fast food using Data Mining. Data Mining is a process of mining/finding hidden or unknown information/pattern from the data using data mining techniques.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Approach for Intrusion Detection Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Due to the advancement of Internet over last decade, network security has turned out to be one of the important areas of research. Therefore, Intrusion Detection (ID) is widely studied to achieve overall network security success. Aim of Intrusion Detection System (IDS) is to put checks on attacks and provide desirable support for defense management along with information about the intrusion. The several intrusion detection approaches are proposed so far to predict malicious traffic from the network. In this paper, existing techniques of intrusion detection are reviewed and a hybrid approach based on SVM and KNN for the network traffic classification is proposed where KNN will be used for feature extraction and SVM will classify the data in different classes based on extracted features.

articleTitle: Improving GPGPU Performance Using Efficient Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Graphics processing units (GPUs) are in demand for executing general purpose parallel applications because of their massive computational power and latency-hiding capability. GPU programming models like CUDA and OPENCL allow programmer to create N number of threads for a kernel. Parallelism is achieved by grouping the threads into fixed size warps and executing many warps simultaneously on a GPU core. In spite of parallel execution the computational resource on GPU cores are still underutilized which degrades the overall performance of GPUs. One of the reasons for this is time disparity in execution of thread block among warps. To improve GPU performance, these resources must be more efficiently utilized by minimizing this time disparity. To eliminate the disadvantages of conventional LRR policy we propose a Lazy Warp Scheduler (LWS). The round robin warp scheduler is inefficient in overlapping the latency stalls. We observed time disparity in execution among warps of same Cooperative Thread Array (CTA) which caused degradation in performance due to the lazy warps. A lazy warp is the warp in the thread block which is taking more time to get executed leading to time disparity. This is due to one of the following reasons like branch divergence, imbalanced workload in parallel warps, memory contention, irregular memory access pattern etc. To overcome this problem, we propose the LWS which classifies the warps into two categories, lazy warp (LW) and fast warp (FW). It schedules the warps of FW categories first giving high priority followed by lazy warps. We used counters to identify which warp is taking more time i.e. lazy warp. Further we proposed LW aware CTA scheduling in which CTA is scheduled on SM on the basis of behavior of warps in a CTA. Our evaluation result shows that LWS can improve the performance of GPGPU applications by 24 % as compared to loose round robin scheduling policy.

articleTitle: Power Quality Improvement in Industrial Drives Using Intelligent Techniques
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: In this paper, a new control techniques for intelligent controller is implemented for uninterruptible power supplies like computer and other applications. In the proposed scheme, conventional active and reactive power theory is implemented and intelligent controller based neural network, neurofuzzy inference system and fuzzy logic system is executed to generate a reference compensated current for shunt active power filter to improve the performance of power quality issues. The switching strategy of voltage controlled active power filter is formulated and corresponding gate pulses is achieved by hysteresis controller. DC link capacitor voltage is regulated by conventional proportional integral controller of voltage control loop. To regulate the source current, hysteresis controller is used that is in phase with current control loop. In the proposed system, various control techniques are designed with shunt active power filter. The results are compared with conventional and intelligent techniques and the system model is implemented using MATLAB simulink environment.

articleTitle: Node Performance Load Balancing Algorithm for Hadoop Cluster
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Hadoop is an implementation of MapReduce algorithm[1]. It operates on Distributed, parallel systems. During the execution of MapReduce applications default hash Partitioning algorithm leads to uneven distribution of load among the reducer tasks. Because of this total execution time gets affected. Hence the algorithm is modified in which it collects the local information, combines them and distributes the data in order to avoid skew. Node performance Load Balancing algorithm is used to reduce the imbalance of the load among the reducers. Due to this the execution time taken to complete the task is reduced.

articleTitle: Review of Data Extraction, Segregation & Privacy with Big Data Analytics in the Online Health Care Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Enormous information is rising innovation now in different territories, i.e. like online purchase, online medical services, tweet investigation, and saving money area. Presently today's insurance agencies are appearing towards investigation of their tremendous data samples comprises of patients & healing center's data. From those informational indexes they extricating some valuable data. For the most part they focus on progress and disappointment rate and input provided by the patients. Patients are going to provide the hospital center bills alongside release outline, medicinal reports to the insurance agency. In point of patient system assurance agency is choosing to endorse case & recommend for newly coming patients. In this paper, patient reports, indications, log records & criticisms are dissected utilizing enormous information innovations like infinispan and guide lessen ideas for information extraction and isolation in E-medical coverage. Uncovering of patients confidential data has been finished utilizing confidential information encrypting calculation.

articleTitle: Filtering and Analysis of Big Data to Improve Performance
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: We are living in an era where Knowledge or Information is the biggest power one would wish to have, with the advancement in the technology and the invention of the smart-phone and 4G the rate of data generation and consumption has increased exponentially. The variety of data generated are in a different format structured, semi-structured, unstructured and redundant, Only 20 to 30 per cent of data is useful out of total generated data, rest can be categorized as noisy or unwanted data. The question arises, is it compulsory To store and particularly process the information either helpful or noisy? Our research paper focuses on extracting useful data leaving out the noisy and redundant data by using the 2 Phase filtering model. In the Proposed architecture, Rule-based filtering, Cluster-based filtering and String matching (using Jaro-distance formula) Algorithm used with Spark to achieve the filtered data.

articleTitle: Mean Threshold Shortest Job Round Robin CPU Scheduling Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: There are two kind of software that runs in our system. They are system software and application software. Operating System is system software that is responsible for handling all other processes that runs on our system. At a time there are various processes that demands for CPU and resources, since job executed only when the job is allotted to CPU. The order of assigning job to CPU is called CPU scheduling. Assigning of CPU to many jobs depends on various factors like their service time, waiting time, priority, response time etc. Once the job has assigned CPU, it do not leave CPU till it's completion in Non-Preemptive scheduling. In Preemptive there is relaxation to leave CPU after assigning it to any job. Generally CPU leaves when it demands for some resources or wants some others task to be done before it, than it resides in main memory or in secondary memory and go in to waiting state or suspend state. There are five states of any job i.e. new, ready, running, waiting and terminating state.

articleTitle: Wearable assistive device for human motion and health monitoring
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: With the growing population, Healthcare services and Monitoring of people are considered as the major needs in the recent years. There are many health monitoring systems which are either used for multi purpose or for a specific needs. On the other hand Assistive Technology (AT) is the one which would help the people to do their regular work without any manual support to meet their Activities of Daily Living (ADLs). The proposed system is a wearable device which could serve the purpose of health and motion monitoring along with an assistive technology. By the data from the accelerometer, microphone and sensors the activity of the person is determined. When there is any variation in the real time values from the default values an alert message will be sent to their close concern. On the other hand an alarm will be given on set time intervals for their regular activities like taking pills, insulin etc.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Color Image Denoising using Geometrical Pixel Location Encoding and Decoding Technique
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: This paper proposed a novel denoising algorithm with a geometrical pixel location. This developed novel denoising algorithm and discussed with reference to the geometrical pixel encoding Process. Many denoising techniques are implemented with high accuracy. Once the image filtered, further improvement in noise improvement is not possible. First, an image is filtered with any denoise technique, then image pixel locations are encoded with defined geometric positions for this encoding technique again filtered with same denoise technique applied earlier. After completion of the denoise process image decoded with original geometric locations. The proposed algorithm is tested with standard denoise techniques. The experimental results show the robustness in upgrading PSNR, SSIM.

articleTitle: A Review on Various Methods for Classification of Massive Noisy Image
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: In image processing there are significant research areas to work on the image but classification of image is one of the most complex area. If the image contains blurred and noisy content, it will make the image classification process as a more complex and challenging task. Irrespective of the tediousness of such image, there are still various techniques to classify the images. If the input image contains high amount of noisy content and blurriness level, then these methods shows some limitations. The image classification results are not satisfactory and the accuracy of the methods are low. Generally, the classification methods are categorized in two main types, they are supervised and unsupervised classification. Both the methods have their own advantages as well as limitations. The main challenge is to obtain a proper and desired result from a noisy image as compared to that of the normal image. In this study we present an analytical review on various image classification techniques.

articleTitle: Techniques for Reducing the Energy Consumption in Nodes of Wireless Sensor Networks: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks(WSNs) are used to sustain an inexpensive solution to many emerging operations such as target detection, environmental monitoring, healthcare, industrial monitoring, and disaster management, etc. by organizing the sensor nodes deployed in the sensor field. To amplify the lifespan of wireless sensor networks and to save energy the various approaches such as clustering, routing, etc have been proposed. The energy holes which are created in the network can be removed by various routing protocols and algorithms. These protocols help to maintain the connectivity of the network and to maintain the activities of the network for long-time. The protocols are designed in such a way that each sensor must be aware of the latest position of the mobile sinks in WSNs. This helps to maintain uniform energy consumption in the network. According to a survey, sensing the classified sensor nodes has many possibilities to improve the lifetime of the network compared to overall sensing in the sensor field.

articleTitle: Presceptive Analysis on Blogostream Enslavement Through Knowledge Representation Using First Order Logic
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
abstract: Knowledge Representation plays vital role in determining feasible solutions to the complex problems. It goes beyond the numerical computations and manipulations. It mainly focuses on problems that require intelligent decision making and processing task that reveals the quality of the given problem. It defines nature and features of the problem that are highly demanded from the development aspect. The knowledge representation techniques illustrate the problem from objected oriented perspective which defines the state and behavior of an object directly related with the stated goal. Goals are categorized into sub goals based on the functionality associated within the object. The required hypothesis needs to be formulated and tested once the respective task is implemented. In this paper, a case study of Internet Addiction is surveyed with internet usage behavior of different categories of users. The problem domain is conceptualized with Knowledge using First Order Logic are demonstrated with possible facts.

articleTitle: Empirical Mode Decomposition with Probabilistic Neural Network and Comparison with Support Vector Machine for Power Quality Events Classification
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Intelligent Sustainable Systems (ICISS)
